text:
Tumse kuch kehne ki chah mein,
Kai shaamein yunhi dhal gayi.
Alfaaz honthon tak aakar ruke,
Aur baat dil mein hi machal gayi.
Suna hai khamoshi bhi pyaar hoti hai,
 Shayad isiliye meri mohabbat badal gayi.
title: Unkahe Jazbaat
description: A soft and heartfelt expression of silent love that remained unspoken, tailored for the PoetryKitaab audience.
